_note: Mainnet TEST values (docs/MAINNET-RUNBOOK.md, 'Mainnet test'): a small real-mainnet run with one key as admin and upgrade authority and a throwaway pump.fun coin as the quote. test.ts fills core_authority, runtime_authority and line_mint from the key directory. The shape and values are the devnet TEST ones (config/network.json; bounty, messages and challenge as scripts/devnet). onchain_epoch_length_s 300 is devnet's too (scripts/devnet/setup.ts): unbond_cooldown_s 600 must be at least two epochs on chain, and Core keeps its own epoch timing. Not launch values: those stay TBA in launch-params.example.json. u64 amounts are strings with an n suffix, in base units of the quote coin (6 decimals).
